test_title: PYST 8: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
R + S means ‘R is the daughter of S’

R = S means ‘R is the father of S’

R ÷ S means ‘R is the wife of S’

R × S means ‘R is the brother of S’

E ÷ F × J + L = M, then how is L related to E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

to S

 
 
 

Statement given : **E ÷ F × J + L = M**

So,

 
• E ÷ F → E is the wife of F.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b33a05d522286931a45d32a3a030ba30790faab5c0b03c0bb263a00660124b83.png] 

 
• F × J → F is the brother of J.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a272ec159a400ba66d76d3ea07a336074f725a262b50bca87c490a40c59fea03.png] 

 
• J + L → J is the daughter of L.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0bd6db0546cdb9184578398cfda877451543d02eda2b2978bc15b1ff0da47cd.png] 

 
• L = M → L is the father of M.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7615ef38ba5f99938b99fc69f764dea000911c0ec81ab08df4745f4a8a85236d.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree L is the father-in-law of E.

Hence, "**Father-in-law**" is the correct answer.
